"""
    For VHDL source code.
    """
    name = 'vhdl'
    aliases = ['vhdl']
    filenames = ['*.vhdl', '*.vhd']
    mimetypes = ['text/x-vhdl']
    url = 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/VHDL'
    version_added = '1.5'
    flags = re.MULTILINE | re.IGNORECASE

    tokens = {
        'root': [
            (r'\s+', Whitespace),
            (r'(\\)(\n)', bygroups(String.Escape, Whitespace)),  # line continuation
            (r'--.*?$', Comment.Single),
            (r"'(U|X|0|1|Z|W|L|H|-)'", String.Char),
            (r'[~!%^&*+=|?:<>/-]', Operator),
            (r"'[a-z_]\w*", Name.Attribute),
            (r'[()\[\],.;\']', Punctuation),
            (r'"[^\n\\"]*"', String),

            (r'(library)(\s+)([a-z_]\w*)',
             bygroups(Keyword, Whitespace, Name.Namespace)),
            (r'(use)(\s+)(entity)', bygroups(Keyword, Whitespace, Keyword)),
            (r'(use)(\s+)([a-z_][\w.]*\.)(all)',
             bygroups(Keyword, Whitespace, Name.Namespace, Keyword)),
            (r'(use)(\s+)([a-z_][\w.]*)',
             bygroups(Keyword, Whitespace, Name.Namespace)),

arguments.command:
PYTHONPATH=. python - <<'PY'
import importlib.util, json, sys
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('ws_hdl', 'pygments/lexers/hdl.py')
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
print(json.dumps({'module_origin': spec.origin}))
from pygments.token import Comment
cases = []
toks = list(mod.VhdlLexer().get_tokens('/* multi\nline */'))
joined = ''.join(t[1] for t in toks)
cases.append({'case': 'vhdl_c_style_multiline_comment', 'pass': str(toks[0][0]) == 'Token.Comment.Multiline' and toks[0][1] == '/* multi\nline */' and joined == '/* multi\nline */\n', 'got': [(str(t[0]), t[1]) for t in toks]})
toks2 = list(mod.VhdlLexer().get_tokens('-- line comment\n'))
cases.append({'case': 'ada_style_comment_unchanged', 'pass': any('Comment.Single' in k for k in [str(t[0]) for t in toks2]), 'got': [str(t[0]) for t in toks2]})
print(json.dumps({'cases': cases}, sort_keys=True))
sys.exit(0 if cases and all(c['pass'] for c in cases) else 1)
PY
